facts.1: You can react to a message faster than explaining that you agree.
facts.2: A voice channel does not judge the kettle near your mic — other participants do.
facts.3: "@everyone" is the fastest way to hear "enough".
facts.4: Unread messages pile up faster than the desire to open them.
facts.5: "Online" does not guarantee an answer in the next five minutes.
facts.6: A pinned message is an important announcement everyone promises to read later.
facts.7: Chat history remembers everything. Even what you already deleted.
facts.8: Editing a message does not erase the memory of those who already read it.
facts.9: An emoji in your nickname is a legal way to take three more pixels of attention.
facts.10: Scrolling up to "the very beginning" is a separate quest rewarded with fatigue.
